A typical daily dose is 250 micrograms in monophasic contraceptive preparations, and 180 to 250 micrograms in tripha- sic preparations. For HRT, a regimen of estradiol daily for 3 days followed by estradiol with norgestimate 90 micrograms daily for 3 days is used; this 6-day cycle is repeated continuously without interruption. Preparations USP 31: Norgestimate and Ethinyl Estradiol Tablets.
